rules.filter_moved_lines: an old-side line of F whose stripped text (non-empty) equals the stripped text of any line F adds in any scope file is ignored before blame
rules.filter_blank_lines: old-side lines that are blank or whitespace-only are ignored before blame
rules.filter_refactor: an introducing commit whose subject matches ^refactor (case-insensitive) is rejected; such commits are also excluded from controls
rules.changed_lines_basis: added+removed vs first parent, --no-renames, scope files only
rules.controls: subject not a fix (tight regex), not ^refactor, not a merge, in date and size range, zero blamed lines from any fix on the UNFILTERED tallies (before the moved/blank filters); items use the filtered tallies
rules.freeze_controls: walk chosen items by ascending sha; each takes the unused control with the closest changed_lines (ties: lower sha); one control per item
